lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgFe2V4O12 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe and V centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Mg adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement around O. Corner-sharing is observed between FeO6 and V6O octahedra, and between FeO6 and Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, with face-sharing also present among FeO6, V6O, and Mg polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
